data.name: Ujwala
data.gender_notes: Ujwala is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ujwala means the flame of knowledge that illuminates the path of life. It represents the inner light that guides us towards wisdom and enlightenment. The name Ujwala carries the meaning “Flame, Light, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Ujwala usually hope their child will grow to embody flame, light, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ujwala is a divine name that signifies the inner light of consciousness and knowledge. It is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, intelligence, and self-realization.
data.etymology: Ujwala belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Flame, Light, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ujwala total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
